purpose: Dark case-study hero with cover image and track illustration

responsive.phone: Track/cover art anchored with a small negative bottom offset (bottom-[-10px], bare).
responsive.tablet: Track art insets from the section edges (tablet:inset-x-[60px] tablet:bottom-[-20px]); cover image gets a fixed 216px height (tablet:h-[216px] tablet:w-[400px]); heading steps to tablet:text-title-t.
responsive.desktop: Track art insets widen further (desktop:inset-x-[130px]); cover image height grows to a fixed 242.4px (desktop:h-[242.4px]); heading steps to desktop:text-title with desktop:text-body-l.
